mapper.select: WITH Walk AS ( SELECT l.ToProductId AS ProductId, 1 AS Steps FROM {{schema}}.ShopProductLinks AS l WHERE l.FromProductId = 1 UNION ALL SELECT n.ToProductId, w.Steps + 1 FROM Walk AS w JOIN {{schema}}.ShopProductLinks AS n ON n.FromProductId = w.ProductId WHERE w.Steps < 3) SELECT DISTINCT w.ProductId AS ProductId FROM Walk AS w OPTION (MAXRECURSION 10)
